meta.description: Starter keyword-cluster catalog for the SF-36v2 codebook (codebook.sf36v2.json). One cluster per subtheme (37 total), seeded with surface-form variants drawn from SF-36v2 item language and common free-text equivalents patients use in interviews / Reddit posts. Variants are SUGGESTION FUEL ONLY — they rank cluster suggestions in the segment tag drawer; they do NOT auto-tag any occurrence. Per-instance tag rows still live in keyword_tags.json keyed by (cluster_id, segment_id, char_start, char_end), same as the live lexicon. Indications and burden_category_ids are intentionally left empty — populate per study as needed.
changelog: sf36v2-1.0 — initial starter lexicon. 37 clusters, one per SF-36v2 subtheme. parent_theme = SF-36v2 scale id (physical_functioning, role_physical, …, mental_health); parent_subtheme = subtheme id from codebook.sf36v2.json. Cluster ids namespaced with `sf36_` prefix to avoid collision with the live lexicon if a downstream loader ever merges the two.
notes: Cluster ids are namespaced `sf36_<subtheme_id>` so the SF-36 starter and live lexicons can coexist without id collisions.

Variants lean toward the language an SF-36v2 respondent or a patient on a forum would naturally use, not the formal scale name. E.g. PF vigorous-activity variants are 'running' / 'lifting heavy' / 'strenuous sports', not 'vigorous activities'.

One cluster per subtheme is a starter. Split into multiple clusters under the same subtheme when a facet earns its own grouping (e.g. mh_depression could split into 'depressed mood' vs 'hopelessness/suicidality').
indications: [] is study-agnostic by default; add indication ids when a cluster only fires within a specific cohort.
burden_category_ids: [] left blank pending review against the burden-category registry.

clusters.label: Vigorous activities
clusters.description: Limitations in running, lifting heavy objects, or strenuous sports (SF-36v2 PF item 1).

clusters.label: Moderate activities
clusters.description: Limitations in moderate activities like moving a table, vacuuming, bowling, or golfing (SF-36v2 PF item 2).

clusters.label: Lifting & carrying groceries
clusters.description: Difficulty lifting or carrying groceries and similar everyday loads (SF-36v2 PF item 3).

clusters.label: Climbing stairs
clusters.description: Difficulty climbing one or several flights of stairs (SF-36v2 PF items 4–5).

clusters.label: Bending, kneeling, stooping
clusters.description: Difficulty bending, kneeling, or stooping (SF-36v2 PF item 6).

clusters.label: Walking distances
clusters.description: Limitations walking — more than a mile, several blocks, or even one block (SF-36v2 PF items 7–9).

clusters.label: Bathing & dressing
clusters.description: Difficulty with bathing, dressing, or basic self-care (SF-36v2 PF item 10).

clusters.label: Mobility aids & adaptations
clusters.description: Use of canes, walkers, wheelchairs, grab bars, or other physical aids; home or environment adaptations to compensate for PF limits.

clusters.label: Cut down time at work
clusters.description: Reducing the amount of time spent on work or other activities because of physical health (SF-36v2 RP item 1).

clusters.label: Accomplished less (physical)
clusters.description: Getting less done than wanted as a result of physical health (SF-36v2 RP item 2).

clusters.label: Limited in kind of work
clusters.description: Restricted in the kind of work or activities that can be done due to physical health (SF-36v2 RP item 3).
variants: kind of work I can do
can't do what I used to

clusters.label: Difficulty performing work
clusters.description: Work or activities take extra effort, longer, or workarounds due to physical health (SF-36v2 RP item 4).

clusters.label: Career & income impact
clusters.description: Job loss, reduced hours, missed promotions, disability leave, or income loss attributed to physical health.

clusters.label: Pain intensity
clusters.description: How much bodily pain — severity, frequency, and pain described as constant or chronic (SF-36v2 BP item 1).

clusters.label: Pain interference
clusters.description: How much pain interferes with normal work, household tasks, hobbies, or daily activities (SF-36v2 BP item 2).

clusters.label: Pain location & quality
clusters.description: Where the pain is felt (back, joints, head, abdomen, neuropathic) and how it is described (sharp, burning, throbbing, aching).

clusters.label: Pain management
clusters.description: Strategies and treatments used to manage pain — medications, procedures, physical therapy, alternative approaches.

clusters.label: Health self-rating
clusters.description: Personal evaluation of overall health (excellent / very good / good / fair / poor) (SF-36v2 GH item 1).

clusters.label: Illness susceptibility
clusters.description: Belief that they get sick more easily than others, or that they are as healthy as anybody (SF-36v2 GH items 2 & 3).

clusters.label: Health outlook
clusters.description: Expectation that health will get worse, stay the same, or improve (SF-36v2 GH item 4).

clusters.label: Health comparison
clusters.description: Comparison of current health to a year ago, to peers, or to a prior baseline.
variants: not what I used to be

clusters.label: Full of life
clusters.description: Feeling lively, vital, full of life — the positive pole of the vitality scale (SF-36v2 VT item 1).

clusters.label: Energy
clusters.description: Having a lot of energy; feeling able to do what one wants to do (SF-36v2 VT item 2).

clusters.label: Worn out
clusters.description: Feeling worn out, drained, or depleted beyond ordinary tiredness (SF-36v2 VT item 3).

clusters.label: Tired
clusters.description: Feeling tired, sluggish, or low-energy in a way attributed to health or treatment (SF-36v2 VT item 4).

clusters.label: Extent of social interference
clusters.description: How much physical or emotional problems interfere with social activities (not at all → extremely) (SF-36v2 SF item 1).
variants: gets in the way of seeing people

clusters.label: Frequency of social interference
clusters.description: How much of the time physical or emotional health has interfered with social activities (SF-36v2 SF item 2).

clusters.label: Relationship strain
clusters.description: Strain on relationships with partners, family, friends, or caregivers attributed to health.

clusters.label: Isolation & withdrawal
clusters.description: Withdrawing from social events, declining invitations, or feeling isolated as a consequence of health.

clusters.label: Cut down time (emotional)
clusters.description: Reducing the amount of time spent on work or other activities because of emotional problems (SF-36v2 RE item 1).
variants: cut down time because of mood
couldn't get out of bed for work

clusters.label: Accomplished less (emotional)
clusters.description: Getting less done than wanted as a result of emotional problems (SF-36v2 RE item 2).
variants: depressed and couldn't get things done

clusters.label: Did work less carefully
clusters.description: Doing work or activities less carefully than usual because of emotional problems (SF-36v2 RE item 3).

clusters.label: Anxiety & nervousness
clusters.description: Feeling very nervous, on edge, or anxious (SF-36v2 MH item 1).

clusters.label: Depression & low mood
clusters.description: Feeling so down nothing could cheer one up; feeling downhearted, depressed, or hopeless (SF-36v2 MH items 2 & 4).

clusters.label: Calm & peaceful
clusters.description: Feeling calm and peaceful — the positive pole of affect balance (SF-36v2 MH item 3).

clusters.label: Happiness
clusters.description: Being a happy person — general positive emotional tone over the recall period (SF-36v2 MH item 5).

clusters.label: Emotional control
clusters.description: Sense of being in (or losing) control of one's emotions or behavior; mood swings; reactivity.
